<ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Guānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>黑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hēi</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>黑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hēi</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>证<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>证<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>证<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>真<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēn</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>亮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>藉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>待<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>情<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>欲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dào</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>充<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>充<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>典<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>真<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēn</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>证<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>反<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>。’”

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>丰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>典<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>藉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>典<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>真<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēn</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>由<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>怀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huái</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>表<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>证<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>：<mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>冷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lěnɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lì</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby>？”

verses.text: <ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>隐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>瞒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。”“<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>旷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>修<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>’，<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>（<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>”）；

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>解<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>鞋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xié</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>配<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pèi</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>旦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bó</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ní</rt></ruby></mark>（<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>古<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>卷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">juàn</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby><ruby>喇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎ</rt></ruby>”），<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>证<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>次<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cì</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>羔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>（<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>背<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>负<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby>”）<ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>孽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby>（<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>”），<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby>？<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby>做<ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>规<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>矩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ju</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>缸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>摆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>盛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>桶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>缸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>缸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>舀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>送<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>筵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>送<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Guǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>筵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>尝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>变<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>舀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。<ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Guǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>筵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>新<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>郎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>摆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>客<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>摆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>次<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>件<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>迹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>农<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nónɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>几<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>逾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>冷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lěnɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 洁净圣殿

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>降<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>（<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>”。<ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby>），<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Guānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>黑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hēi</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>恶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">è</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>恨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hèn</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>责<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zé</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>真<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēn</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>监<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>辩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>礼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lā</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>旦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby>、<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>证<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>变<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>酒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>臣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>迦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>农<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nónɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>患<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huàn</rt></ruby><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>医<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>迹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>奇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>总<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>臣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shenɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>趁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chèn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Huí</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>！”<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>迎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>昨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zuó</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>热<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rè</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>退<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>”<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>件<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>迹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>期<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>冷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lěnɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rán</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>肯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>果<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>书<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>写<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>书<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>渡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dù</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>提<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tí</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>哩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lī</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby></mark>。
