verses.text: <ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>迹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>随<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suí</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>逾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>举<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>目<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>腓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Féi</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>买<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>饼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”（

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>试<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>验<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>腓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Féi</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>。）

<mark class="pn"><ruby>腓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Féi</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>银<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>饼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>点<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>够<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡòu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ān</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>烈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

“<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>童<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>麦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mài</rt></ruby><ruby>饼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>条<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>鱼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>算<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suàn</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>草<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>目<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>千<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiān</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>役<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>迷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mí</rt></ruby><ruby>惑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>官<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Guān</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>咒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>诅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ní</rt></ruby><ruby>哥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

“<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bù</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>供<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>查<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chá</rt></ruby><ruby>考<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>；<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>橄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>榄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，

verses.text: <ruby>清<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>淫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>淫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>律<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>该<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāi</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>试<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>探<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>弯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wān</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>腰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yāo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>画<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>字<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>曾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>谎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>遵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>犯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>犯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>趁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chèn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bái</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>须<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby>做<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>黑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hēi</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>敬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>、<ruby>遵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>旨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby>！”<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>拜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nán</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>瞎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiā</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>瞎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiā</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>；<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>’，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>。”

“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>圈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">juàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>爬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pá</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>贼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zéi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 羊圈的比喻

verses.text: <ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>牧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kān</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jì</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>跑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pǎo</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 好牧人耶稣

verses.text: <ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>贼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zéi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>；<ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>草<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>盗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dào</rt></ruby><ruby>贼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zéi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>非<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>偷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tōu</rt></ruby><ruby>窃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>坏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huài</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>（<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>”）<ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>更<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>丰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>牧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>牧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>舍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shě</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>雇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>牧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>狼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>撇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">piě</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby>；<ruby>狼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>抓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuā</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>散<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>群<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qún</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>件<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>迹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>真<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>患<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huàn</rt></ruby><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lā</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bó</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ní</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>姐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>姐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jie</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>村<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cūn</rt></ruby><ruby>庄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuānɡ</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>香<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>膏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>抹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>擦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cā</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>患<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huàn</rt></ruby><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lā</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>姐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>妹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>素<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>妹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lā</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lā</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rán</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lā</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bái</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bái</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>黑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hēi</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>跌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diē</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>随<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suí</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>朋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>友<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">you</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lā</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>睡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>醒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>睡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>迎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<mark class="pn"><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>，　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dɑo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>末<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>虽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suī</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>临<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>妹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mèi</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>马<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yà</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>。”
